employees.get.description: Retrieve one BambooHR employee by ID via GET /api/v1/employees/{id}. Optional fields are comma-joined; optional onlyCurrent is passed as a query flag.
employees.get.title: Get employee

employees.list.description: List BambooHR employees for the connected company.
employees.list.title: List employees

fields.list.description: List BambooHR employee fields available to the connected account.
fields.list.title: List fields

ats.create_candidate.description: Create a BambooHR ATS candidate application via POST /api/v1/applicant_tracking/application.
ats.create_candidate.title: Create candidate application

ats.create_job_opening.description: Create a BambooHR ATS job opening via POST /api/v1/applicant_tracking/job_opening.
ats.create_job_opening.title: Create job opening

ats.get_applications.description: List BambooHR ATS applications via GET /api/v1/applicant_tracking/applications.
ats.get_applications.title: List job applications

ats.get_hiring_leads.description: List employees who can own BambooHR ATS job openings via GET /api/v1/applicant_tracking/hiring_leads.
ats.get_hiring_leads.title: Get hiring leads

ats.get_job_summaries.description: List BambooHR ATS job summaries via GET /api/v1/applicant_tracking/jobs.
ats.get_job_summaries.title: Get job summaries

ats.get_statuses.description: List BambooHR ATS applicant statuses via GET /api/v1/applicant_tracking/statuses.
ats.get_statuses.title: Get applicant statuses

benefit.get_coverages.description: List standard BambooHR benefit coverages via GET /api/v1/benefitcoverages. Optional coverageId is honored by the handwritten handler as GET /api/v1/benefitcoverages/{id}.
benefit.get_coverages.title: Get benefit coverages

benefit.get_member_events.description: List BambooHR member benefit events via GET /api/v1/benefit/member_benefit.
benefit.get_member_events.title: Get member benefit events

company.get_eins.description: Retrieve company Employer Identification Numbers via GET /api/v1/company/eins.
company.get_eins.title: Get company EINs

datasets.list.description: List BambooHR dataset schemas via GET /api/v1/datasets.
datasets.list.title: List datasets

dependents.create.description: Add a dependent on an employee via POST /api/v1/employeedependents.
dependents.create.title: Create employee dependent

dependents.get_all.description: List all employee dependents via GET /api/v1/employeedependents.
dependents.get_all.title: Get all employee dependents

employees.changed.description: List employees inserted, updated, or deleted since a timestamp via GET /api/v1/employees/changed.
employees.changed.title: Get changed employees

employees.create.description: Create a BambooHR employee via POST /api/v1/employees. The 201 Location header is returned under data.location.
employees.create.title: Create employee

employees.custom_fields.description: List BambooHR field metadata (including custom employee fields) via GET /api/v1/meta/fields.
employees.custom_fields.title: Get custom employee fields

employees.directory.description: Retrieve the BambooHR employee directory via GET /api/v1/employees/directory.
employees.directory.title: Get all employees

employees.files.create_category.description: Create employee file categories via POST /api/v1/employees/files/categories with a JSON array of names.
employees.files.create_category.title: Create employee file category

employees.photo.description: Retrieve an employee photo via GET /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/photo/{size}. JSON fixtures parse as JSON; the handwritten handler base64-encodes binary image bodies.
employees.photo.title: Get employee photo

employees.update.description: Update BambooHR employee fields via POST /api/v1/employees/{employeeId} with a JSON object of field aliases.
employees.update.title: Update employee

files.create_category.description: Create company file categories via POST /api/v1/files/categories with a JSON array of names.
files.create_category.title: Create company file category

files.list.description: List company file categories and files via GET /api/v1/files/view.
files.list.title: List company files

files.upload.description: Upload a company file via POST /api/v1/files. The compiled request sends category, fileName, and share as form fields; the handwritten handler sends multipart when rawContent is present.
files.upload.title: Upload company file

lists.list.description: List BambooHR list-field metadata and options via GET /api/v1/meta/lists.
lists.list.title: Get list field details

meta.countries.description: Retrieve country list-field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/lists (BambooHR stores countries as a list field).
meta.countries.title: Get country options

meta.departments.description: Retrieve department list-field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/lists.
meta.departments.title: Get departments metadata

meta.divisions.description: Retrieve division list-field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/lists.
meta.divisions.title: Get divisions metadata

meta.employment_statuses.description: Retrieve employment-status list-field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/lists.
meta.employment_statuses.title: Get employment status metadata

meta.job_titles.description: Retrieve job-title list-field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/lists.
meta.job_titles.title: Get job title metadata

meta.locations.description: Retrieve location list-field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/lists.
meta.locations.title: Get location metadata

reports.custom.description: Run an ad-hoc custom report via POST /api/v1/reports/custom. The handwritten handler GETs /api/v1/reports/{reportId} when reportId is supplied.
reports.custom.title: Run custom report

reports.custom.list.description: List saved custom reports via GET /api/v1/custom-reports.
reports.custom.list.title: List saved custom reports

reports.get.description: Fetch a built-in or published report via GET /api/v1/reports/{reportId}.
reports.get.title: Get report

reports.list.description: List available company and custom reports via GET /api/v1/meta/reports.
reports.list.title: List company reports

tables.list.description: List tabular table field metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/tables.
tables.list.title: Get tabular fields metadata

timeOff.balances.description: Estimate time-off balances for one employee via GET /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/time_off/calculator. employeeId is required on the compiled path; employee_ids is accepted as an alias.
timeOff.balances.title: Get time-off balances

timeOff.changeStatus.description: Change a time-off request status via PUT /api/v1/time_off/requests/{requestId}/status.
timeOff.changeStatus.title: Update time-off request

timeOff.request.description: Submit a time-off request via PUT /api/v1/employees/{employeeId}/time_off/request.
timeOff.request.title: Create time-off request

timeOff.requests.description: List time-off requests in a date range via GET /api/v1/time_off/requests.
timeOff.requests.title: Get time-off requests

timeOff.types.description: List time-off type metadata via GET /api/v1/meta/time_off/types.
timeOff.types.title: Get time-off types
